headline: EPS more than triples year-over-year
summary_short: Mitsubishi Estate reported Q2 FY2026 basic EPS of ¥79.17, up 207.5% y/y from ¥25.75.
summary_long: Basic EPS of ¥79.17 more than tripled year-over-year, up 207.5% from ¥25.75, and rose a further 45.7% sequentially from ¥54.35 in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
